title: key_persistence.py:264 non-constant-time checksum comparison
description: FileKeyStore._read_slot() uses 'if stored_checksum != expected_checksum:' (line 264) instead of hmac.compare_digest(). This is a timing side-channel on slot checksum validation. Practical impact is limited (requires file access + timing oracle on a reference implementation), but for consistency with other crypto code in this module, use constant-time comparison. The module already imports hmac in trust.py for this purpose.
